notes.title: Patch 1 - Bug Fixes & Added Display Options
notes.content: [list][*][p]🛠️ Fixed cart collision issue: you can now move immediately after removing blocking objects[/p][/*][*][p]⌨️ Added proper cart driving controls for QWERTY keyboard users[/p][/*][*][p]🖥️ New screen mode options: fullscreen, windowed, and borderless (available in settings)[/p][/*][*][p]🚪 Improved cart exit logic: you now exit in the opposite direction you were driving[/p][/*][/list]
